title: Sins of the Father
logline: A wealthy heir tries to buy erased sin records from a local confessional broker, but a disgraced mechanic stole the drive first to clear their own name.

roles.description: Needs to erase their family's confessed crimes before an inheritance hearing.
Sells black-market absolution data captured from rigged confessional booths.
Lost everything after taking the fall for an accident the heir caused.
A battered repair tug rigged with mining lasers.
An automated spiritual advice kiosk in a busy station concourse.

public_situation: The {role:confessional_booth} was ripped out of the wall overnight. Station security thinks it was random vandalism.
private_truth: The {role:sin_broker} rigged the booth to record confessions. The {role:disgraced_mechanic} stole it to prove the {role:corrupt_heir} confessed to the accident that ruined the mechanic's life.

beats.public_change: The sin broker quietly puts out a bounty for the return of the booth's internal memory core.

missions.reason: Hires the pilot to scan the ruined booth for the specific transponder frequency of the stolen memory core.
missions.private_fact: The broker knows the core contains highly illegal blackmail material.

beats.public_change: The mechanic begins broadcasting fragments of the heir's confession on open channels.

missions.reason: The mechanic asks the pilot to fetch a decryption key they hid near the booth so they can unlock the rest of the audio.
missions.private_fact: The mechanic has nothing left to lose and expects to be killed.

beats.public_change: The heir panics and hires mercenaries to silence the mechanic permanently.

missions.reason: The heir pays the pilot an exorbitant sum to track down and destroy the mechanic's tug.
missions.private_fact: The mechanic will hail the pilot, offering to give them the drive to broadcast the truth if they spare the tug.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot destroys the mechanic's tug.
resolutions.summary: The mechanic dies and the drive is destroyed. The heir inherits their fortune without issue, and the broker finds a new racket.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot spares the mechanic and broadcasts the truth.
resolutions.summary: The full confession airs system-wide. The heir loses everything and goes to prison, while the mechanic's name is cleared.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot blasted an heir's tearful murder confession across every comm channel in the sector.

resolutions.summary: The broker's other mercs kill the mechanic and recover the drive. The heir is blackmailed forever.

loose_threads.detail: The broker's terminal was uploading the confession logs to a drop-box registered to an orphanage charity.
The cred-sticks the heir uses to pay for mercs bear the stamp of a dead bank that collapsed thirty years ago.

radio_hooks: Vandals destroy local {role:confessional_booth}; station security baffled.
Bizarre audio transmissions interrupting local sports broadcasts.

voice_direction.corrupt_heir: Trembling, furious, tries to sound commanding but fails.
voice_direction.sin_broker: Oily, calm, always sounds like they are smiling.
